title: Linearity of explicit module cohomology map data
statement: For explicit ModuleCohomologyFMapData, its map on cohomology is induced by a morphism of modules over O_Y(Y), after restricting scalars along h.appTop.hom.

proof.text: Construct the map on homology in the category of O_Y(Y)-modules. Every component map of sheaves is linear on sections; restriction of scalars makes the comparison map linear. Homology and the resolution comparison isomorphisms preserve linearity, and the inverse of the quasi-isomorphism-induced linear isomorphism is linear.
